Our office attended the Completion Celebration for the Hilton Head Island Airport Terminal Improvements Phase 1. 

This is a huge milestone for the Lowcountry. The airport already welcomed its first flight into the new terminal, marking a new chapter for Hilton Head Island. 

South Carolina STRONG.

Until we see arrests, the American people will continue to seek answers. And we will keep working to get them.

Last week, we were one of only a few Members of Congress to depose Ted Waitt, billionaire and boyfriend of Ghislaine Maxwell.

We will not stop until we deliver answers and justice. Not just because it is our job, but because it is our moral duty.

Video

WEEKLY UPDATE FROM WASHINGTON 🇺🇸

FARM BILL — FIRST TIME SINCE 2018
The House passed the Farm Bill this week, delivering for our farmers, ranchers, and rural communities. Our office filed eight amendments to improve the bill, and three were made in order by the Rules Committee and passed the full House:
Mace Amendment #29 – Codifies the newly established Office of Seafood within the USDA. This matters for the Lowcountry. Our fishing communities deserve a permanent seat at the table.

We have now received the files from our subpoena motion of Congress's taxpayer-funded sexual harassment slush fund. 

They reveal taxpayers have paid more than $300,000 in settlements paid on behalf of six former Members of the House of Representatives or their offices. 

Congress has spent decades hiding this from the American people. Taxpayers didn't sign up to foot the bill for cover-ups. They deserve to know their hard-earned dollars were used to cover up sexual harassment by their own elect
Two illegal immigrants having a child in the United States does not make the child a citizen. It makes a third illegal. Time to close the loophole.

South Carolina is NOT a sanctuary state. It never will be.

Right here in the Lowcountry, we had a sanctuary sheriff named Kristin Graziano who refused to cooperate with federal immigration enforcement and put South Carolina families at risk.

We helped get her fired. Charleston County voters made it clear they don't want a sheriff who puts sanctuary policies over their safety. 

In South Carolina, we enforce the law and we protect our people.

Every day is Cinco De Mayo for Chuck Schumer and the Left. Illegals first, America last.


The White House (@WhiteHouse)

Happy Cinco de Mayo to all who celebrate!





— https://nitter.net/WhiteHouse/status/2051678505805496589#m

We have introduced over a dozen pieces of legislation to crack down on illegal immigration. 

From prioritizing funding for communities cooperating with federal immigration enforcement, to giving federal immigration officers the authority they need to deport illegal aliens faster, to blocking federal funding for public colleges and universities offering in-state tuition or financial aid to illegal immigrants.

This is America. We are a country built on laws. Follow them, or don't come here.

Whe

If you are genuinely worried about illegal immigrant families being split up by deportations, stop encouraging them to come here and have anchor babies. 

Problem solved.

The results of my subpoena of Congress’s sexual harassment slush fund are in.

Nine members. One thousand pages.

All records prior to 2004 were destroyed - which tells you everything you need to know about how long this has been buried.

We are reviewing every page. We will name all nine. We will release the full 1,000 pages - once we confirm that personally identifiable information of victims and witnesses has been properly redacted.

Accountability is not a threat. It is a promise.

To every predator in office abusing their power, abusing staffers, abusing women, you should be scared. 

We are on a mission to expose it all and we are just getting started. Sunlight is the best disinfectant. 

If you haven't already, read our piece in the New York Times: nytimes.com/2026/05/02/us/po…

It's National Small Business Week.

From the Lowcountry to the Upstate, small businesses are the backbone of South Carolina. The men and women running them work tirelessly every single day to keep our communities strong and our economy moving. We will always be here to support you. Get out there and shop local.

South Carolina STRONG.

Our amendment on Violet's Law making it into the House-passed Farm Bill is a win for animal rights across the country.

Dogs, cats, primates, hamsters, guinea pigs, and rabbits used in government-funded labs will no longer be put down when their time there is done. They will be rehomed and given the second chance they deserve.

Taxpayer dollars should never fund a death sentence for innocent animals.

Video

A government working for the American people makes sure money stays with the American people.


Speaker Mike Johnson (@SpeakerJohnson)

MILLIONS of small business owners around the country are seeing MORE MONEY in their pockets. 

For Main Street, the average tax reduction is nearly $7,000, thanks to Congressional Republicans and @POTUS's Working Families Tax Cuts.

Remember: The Democrats voted AGAINST you keeping your money.





— https://nitter.net/SpeakerJohnson/status/2051356326010192366#m

This is happening far too often. Praying for President Trump's safety today and every day.


Eric Daugherty (@EricLDaugh)

🚨 NOW: Secret Service confirms an individual has been SHOT by law enforcement near the Washington monument — and the White House was briefly locked down during the incident, per AP

"ALL CLEAR" given and President Trump is safe, thank God 🙏🏻

Video

This week we were one of few members who deposed billionaire Ted Waitt on his relationship with Ghislaine Maxwell.

His answer to too many questions was “I do not recall."

A billionaire with a close relationship to one of the most notorious enablers of child sex trafficking in history who visited the home of the former President of the United States, and his memory just happens to fail him. Particularly convenient.

Let's be clear about what is happening here. Powerful, wealthy men have spent y

Release the unredacted files. Prosecute the predators. Make the arrests.

The victims of Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell have waited too long for justice. We made a personal promise to them and to ourselves to never stop until we deliver the accountability they deserve.

We won't stop until they get the justice they deserve.
